description: DRAFT for review. Dialogue-capable multilingual TTS: Bailing-MoE-V3 backbone (7.9B total / 1.3B active), flow-matching acoustic head, audio VAE and CAMPPlus speaker conditioning. Adds the upstream multi-speaker `podcast` task, which the 0.5B family does not have.

request.name: template_name
request.description: Upstream task mode. Defaults to voice_design on the design route, otherwise seed for Chinese/English and multilingual for the other languages. `podcast` is the only multi-speaker mode. NOTE for review: this extends the ming3_tts template set with `seed`, `paralinguistic` and `podcast`; it does not add new audio.cpp tasks.

request.name: language
request.description: Target language name or code. Required by multilingual (German, Spanish, French, Korean, Japanese) and honoured by seed, paralinguistic and podcast; ignored by basic, emotion, dialect, ip, voice_design and freeform.

request.name: instruct
request.description: Voice description for voice_design, raw instruction for freeform, and optional raw conditioning for seed/tts. TODO(verify): upstream api.py names this `instruction`; confirm the accepted spelling for this family.

request.name: instruction_schema
request.description: Structured instruction field language; defaults to en for dialect, otherwise zh.

request.name: speed
request.description: Categorical speaking speed for the basic template, not waveform resampling.

request.name: pitch
request.description: Categorical pitch for the basic template.

request.name: volume
request.description: Categorical volume for the basic template.

request.name: emotion
request.description: Emotion label for the emotion template. Upstream also accepts English aliases that map onto these labels.

request.name: dialect
request.description: Dialect for the dialect template. Upstream alias table maps `chuanyu dialect` and `cantonese` onto these labels.

request.name: voice_id
request.description: Built-in voice for the ip template. TODO(verify): upstream ip ids are not enumerated in task_protocol.py; confirm the published list rather than inheriting the 0.5B four.

request.name: reference_text
request.description: Transcript accompanying a single reference voice_ref; enables the acoustic reference prefix.

request.name: speaker_references
request.description: PROPOSED. Podcast only: one reference wav per speaker, positional (speaker_1, speaker_2, ...). Upstream requires the count to match the speaker ids used in the script. Alternative accepted names for review: `voice_samples` (MOSS-TTSD convention) or reusing `voice_ref` as a list.

request.name: speaker_reference_texts
request.description: PROPOSED. Podcast only: one transcript per speaker reference, positional. Serialised upstream as ` speaker_N:<text>\n` with a leading space; the runtime must reproduce that form.

request.name: speaker_embedding_file
request.description: CAMPPlus embedding file or list, shape [192] or [1, 192].

request.name: export_speaker_embedding_file
request.description: Export the enabled reference CAMPPlus embedding as F32 Safetensors.

request.name: use_speaker_embedding
request.description: Condition on the reference speaker embedding.

request.name: zero_speaker_embedding
request.description: Use a zero projected speaker row instead of reference conditioning.

request.name: max_tokens
request.description: Maximum generated acoustic patches per fragment. TODO: upstream tiny context is not the 0.5B's 512 positions; set the default after measuring.

request.name: guidance_scale
request.description: Flow guidance (upstream FORMAL_CFG = 2.0).

request.name: sigma
request.description: Flow SDE noise scale (upstream FORMAL_SIGMA = 0.25).

request.name: temperature
request.description: Flow sampling temperature (upstream FORMAL_TEMPERATURE = 0.0).

request.name: flow_steps
request.description: Euler steps for the flow head (upstream FORMAL_FLOW_STEPS = 10). Not present in the ming3_tts spec; needed here if the runtime exposes it.

request.name: seed
request.description: Reference-posterior and generation noise seed. The podcast template must default to 1235 (upstream FORMAL_PODCAST_SEED), so the effective default is per-template.

request.name: raw_text
request.description: Send the text as one fragment without frontend chunking. Must stay off for podcast: dialogue cannot be chunked because speaker ownership depends on the preceding tags.

request.name: text_chunk_size
request.description: Framework long-form chunk budget in Unicode codepoints.

request.name: text_chunk_mode
request.description: Framework text chunking policy.

request.name: trim_silence
request.description: Trim trailing low-energy 100-ms frames per fragment, retaining a 300-ms tail.

session.name: reference_cache
session.description: Reuse prepared conditioning for the most recently used reference waveform. For podcast this must be keyed on the whole reference set, not one file.
